title: Wullaango Nanaango Dow Noddaango
intro: Aɗa nana daande ummotoonde e renndo ngo tooñannge wonti ko woodaani. Alaa kollirgol doole jaabotoo wullitaango ngoo ; kono eeraango toowngo ina yettoo Alla, jaabawol ngol ina fiyra ɓernde dewal e hoore mum. Hol baɗɗo ndeen wullitaango, hol naamnal rewi heen, hol goonga tabitinaaɗo ?
clues: Mi wonti ƴattoore e tooñannge yimɓe wonɓe e sara am.
Mi daande oon wullitaango to Alla e nder wullitaango am.
Alla nani wullitaango ngoo, jaabii e caɗeele ko fayti e gooŋɗinal am.
Jaabawol ngol naamndii hol no mbaawir mi waasde goongɗinde Alla gooto, toowɗo.
Mi naamndii ndeen hol ko waɗi Alla ina foti weltinde leñol ngol keefeeraani.
Miin woni Uzair, inniraaɗo e nder suura Az-Zukhruf ko mo wullitaango mum Alla nani.

identity.label: Hol ko ngonmi?
options: Usayir
Sehil jahroowo e ilam mawɗam
Maccuɗo jahoowo dow ndiyam
Ɗaaniiɗo oo ina reeni e nder ngaska
Maccuɗo gadduɗo kaaƴe e maayo

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Wullaade Allah e tooñannge leñol ngol
Yahde e dow ndiyam e nder henndu
Naatde kaaƴe e maayo ngo alaa ndiyam

trial.answer: Wullaade Allah e tooñannge leñol ngol

location.label: Elemen keyɗo
options: Wullitaango toowngo feewde e Alla
Sawru ndu wonti mboddi
Fuurde waɗnde cooyngal e jam
Laana ina ɓuuɓtoo dow ndiyam ilam
Liɗɗi ina muña maccuɗo

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Alla nani wullitaango ngoo, o tabitini Gootol Alla e Joomiraawo Toowɗo
Yahde e dow ndiyam e jam e nder henndu
Taƴde ilam mawɗam e jam e nder laana
Heɓtude gite nder galle mawnikinaare
Jaɓde laamu nguu ina yaaji gila Fuɗnaange haa Hirnaange
outcome.answer: Alla nani wullitaango ngoo, o tabitini Gootol Alla e Joomiraawo Toowɗo

arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him. (43:7)
